## Summary

Describe the problem and the smallest useful change.

## Compatibility and data safety

- [ ] Existing documents, sources, provenance, Wiki, users, and conversations are preserved.
- [ ] Schema changes include a versioned migration and rollback notes.
- [ ] No mandatory cloud service, telemetry, vector stack, or commercial restriction was added.
